const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab non-hammer tools placement episode controller.
+
+Run this file with the RoboLab rcb_client available on PYTHONPATH. Actions are
+split into short, inspectable stages so the live run can be stopped/revised
+between grasps if an object shifts.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0])
+
+
+def connect():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, label):
+    d = OUT / label
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, rgb in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
+    for cam, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f"{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def pixel_world(obs, camera, u, v, radius=2):
+    """Back-project one RGB-D pixel into env-local world coordinates."""
+    depth = obs.last_depth[camera]
+    patch = depth[max(0, v-radius):v+radius+1, max(0, u-radius):u+radius+1]
+    valid = patch[patch > 0]
+    if not len(valid):
+        raise ValueError(f"no depth at ({u},{v}) in {camera}")
+    z = float(np.median(valid))
+    K = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    E = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    pc = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0], (v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], z, 1.0])
+    T = np.eye(4)
+    T[:3, :] = E
+    return np.linalg.inv(T) @ pc
+
+
+def pose(x, y, z, grip=0, quat=DOWN):
+    return np.r_[np.array([x, y, z], dtype=float), quat, float(grip)]
+
+
+def move(r, xyz, grip=None, quat=DOWN, video="mp4", note=""):
+    p = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+    if grip is None:
+        grip = float(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][15])
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", [pose(*p, grip=grip, quat=quat)], video=video, note=note)
+    print("move", np.round(p, 3).tolist(), "grip", grip,
+          "plan", result.meta.get("plan"), "done", result.meta.get("done"),
+          "time_left", result.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    return result
+
+
+def grip(r, closed, video="mp4", note=""):
+    now = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    p = np.r_[now[8:11], now[11:15], float(bool(closed))]
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", [p], video=video, note=note)
+    print("grip", bool(closed), "opening", result.meta["proprio"]["now"][24],
+          "done", result.meta.get("done"), "time_left", result.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    return result
+
+
+def observe(r, label, depth=True):
+    obs = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="none")
+    save_obs(obs, label)
+    print("observed", label, "time_left", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+          "tcp", np.round(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], 3).tolist(),
+          "opening", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][24])
+    return obs
+
+
+def run():
+    r = connect()
+    print(json.dumps({k: r.spec().get(k) for k in ("protocol", "robot", "control_hz", "budget")}, indent=2))
+    obs = observe(r, "start", depth=True)
+    # Continue the live, staged grasp-and-place sequence here.
+    print("Ready for staged execution.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
